deployments_detail.use: GitHub Copilot rolled out under 'controlled release' to Akamai software engineers; CIO Kate Prouty reports some projects completing in hours instead of weeks, with AI-generated code still requiring human fixes. Cursor and Claude also being tested internally. [GitHub Copilot (Microsoft); also evaluating Cursor and Anthropic Claude]
Akamai Inference Cloud — distributed edge AI inference platform w/ NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs in 17 cities (launched 2025)

Guardicore AI, a generative-AI-powered chatbot embedded in Akamai Guardicore Segmentation that acts as a built-in Zero Trust/segmentation expert: querying network traffic in natural language, creating log filters, and converting natural language to SQL for the Insight feature. Began rolling out to existing customers in Q2 2024. [not disclosed]

AI labeling in Akamai Guardicore Segmentation: generative-AI 'Discovery AI' automatically suggests and generates enforcement-ready labels for discovered/unknown network assets based on process communications, mapping application dependencies. [not disclosed]

Akamai Firewall for AI, a purpose-built security product that applies AI-based guardrails to inputs and outputs of LLM/GenAI applications and AI-driven APIs, protecting against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and toxic output. [Akamai]

Akamai Inference Cloud, a distributed AI-inference platform launched with NVIDIA that places AI inference (including agentic AI) closer to end users, built on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs across Akamai's edge network. [NVIDIA (RTX PRO Blackwell GPUs)]

Akamai AI Grid: production rollout of NVIDIA AI Grid intelligent orchestration for distributed AI inference, routing inference workloads across Akamai's 4,400+ edge locations (first global-scale implementation of NVIDIA AI Grid). [NVIDIA (AI Grid, Blackwell GPUs)]

Anthropic signed a seven-year, $1.8 billion cloud computing deal with Akamai to run Claude AI inference workloads on Akamai's distributed edge infrastructure and NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs — Akamai serving as AI compute provider for a frontier model developer. [Anthropic (Claude) on Akamai infrastructure]

Adaptive Security Engine in Akamai App & API Protector uses machine learning, anomaly risk scoring, and adaptive threat profiling to automatically detect and mitigate web/API attacks; extended in 2024 with a behavioral DDoS engine and in 2026 with AI-powered WAF detections. [Akamai (proprietary ML)]

Akamai Bot Manager uses supervised and unsupervised machine learning / AI models plus behavioral analysis and browser fingerprinting to detect and mitigate malicious bot traffic at the edge, including newer AI-powered bots. [Akamai (proprietary ML/AI)]

Akamai Account Protector uses machine learning and behavioral/telemetry analysis to detect account abuse and takeover across the account lifecycle, assigning real-time risk scores; 2024 update added new-account-opening abuse detection. [Akamai (proprietary ML)]

Internal sales chatbot built with Dataiku that combines OpenAI LLMs with proprietary Akamai customer data, letting sales staff gather public and private customer information before pitches. [Dataiku + OpenAI]
